styles.name: seedling
styles.description: Seeds in a soil bed sprout left to right: a hooked shoot straightens and opens two swaying seed leaves

styles.name: fern-fiddlehead
styles.description: A fern fiddlehead unrolls from a tight coil into an open frond as progress advances

styles.name: bamboo-shoot
styles.description: Bamboo culm grows segment by segment upward; joints appear at each node as progress rises

styles.name: ivy-trellis
styles.description: Ivy winds left to right across a wooden diamond-lattice trellis, sprouting fluttering three-lobed leaves

styles.name: cactus-arms
styles.description: Three saguaro cacti rise in turn, sprout elbowed arms and a pink crown flower while a tumbleweed rolls by

styles.name: sunflower-seeds
styles.description: A row of sunflowers opens left to right: yellow petals ring a brown disc packed with spiral seeds

styles.name: mushroom-cap
styles.description: Red spotted toadstools pop up left to right: a cream stalk rises, then the domed cap swells and puffs spores

styles.name: succulent-rosette
styles.description: A potted echeveria fans open: plump sage-green leaves with pink tips spread outward from the centre

styles.name: root-system
styles.description: Soil cutaway under a sprout: cream roots snake right through speckled earth, forking rootlets with wriggling tips

styles.name: bonsai
styles.description: A bonsai in a terracotta pot: the twisting trunk grows, branches reach out and cloud-pad foliage swells
